usage: Hero current weather and tomorrow summary. Other SVG icons receive selective CSS color accents. Monochrome text and graphs retained.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production weather illustration, transparent cutout, designed to read beautifully at 112–144 CSS pixels on top of a blue photographic sky.
Primary request: ONE original premium dimensional SUNNY WEATHER icon, not an interface mockup or icon sheet.
Subject: one warm golden sun, a softly rounded amber-to-honey glass orb with exactly eight short, rounded, three-dimensional rays; very subtle molten-gold inner light, richer amber along the lower edge. Clear elegant silhouette, no facial features.
Style/medium: sophisticated miniature 3D sculpture with satin glass and softly polished ceramic-like surfaces, gentle volumetric depth, considered natural highlights; refined editorial weather-app illustration, not flat emoji, not clip art, not a plastic toy.
Composition/framing: single centered object, front view with a very slight three-quarter depth; whole silhouette visible with approximately 12% clear padding around it, square canvas.
Lighting/mood: soft studio key from upper left with a cool delicate rim, crisp object edges and restrained highlights, no excessive bloom.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background. No sky, no white or colored backdrop, no checkerboard drawn into the image, no ground, no floor shadow, no badge or enclosing circle.
Constraints: no text, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no border, no sparkles, no extra objects. The icon itself should be fully opaque except for restrained material translucency. Render only the sun.
